adidas China, measured

Every value on this page is a CSS custom property generated from tokens.json, measured on the live China flagship storefront at adidas.com.cn: strict monochrome — black on white with three grey steps, Adihaus DIN with PingFang SC fallback, bold 14/20 button labels, square corners, 48px controls. The drawings below are rebuilt from the tokens; the real pixels are in screenshots/ and components/crops/.

Read from adidas.com.cn on 2026-11-10, publicly, signed out — the global adidas.com storefront is Akamai-blocked from the capture environment, so this package covers the China flagship. Adihaus DIN and adineuePRO are proprietary and not loaded here: they fall back to PingFang SC / Helvetica.

Colour

Strict monochrome: black text and hairlines on white ground, grey steps for muted text (#9a9b9b), disabled borders (#c8cbcc) and light surfaces (#eceff1, #f9f9f9). No accent colour was measured on the public surface.

Typography

Adihaus DIN carries the site with PingFang SC as the CJK fallback; adineuePRO sets display headings. Scale runs 11-40px: 11/16 small print, 13/18 small text, 15/20 bold nav labels, 14/20 bold button labels, 16/24 body, 18/22 bold prices, 24/30 headings.

Shape, sizes and space

Every corner is square — radius 0 across the storefront. Buttons share one 48px height with 16px side padding; the header rail is 124px; product tiles run 338.5 x 454.5; the footer is a 360px block. Edges are always 1px hairlines; paddings are small and grid-bound.

Radius

Focus

Buttons and nav items paint no focus style (focusRing.width is 0px); text links take the browser's own ring — footer-link measured outline: 1px auto #005fcc, Chromium's default.

controls · 0px — no painted ring
links · browser 1px auto #005fcc

Motion

Instant: every measured control reports transition-duration: 0s — hover, focus and pressed colour flips have no easing. The header bar itself carries all 0.3s ease-in; the readable stylesheets' declared transitions are listed in raw/measurements.md. Click a track to play it.

Layout

A 124px header rail (a 40px black utility strip over an 84px nav bar), then the 540px full-bleed campaign band and a fluid product grid. The PLP runs ~338px cards; the PDP is a two-column canvas — gallery left, a ~400px purchase column right. Hairline 1px rules separate everything.
